citation.authors: Pilis K, Rojczyk E, Valach P, et al.
citation.title: Effect of 8 days of water-only fasting and exercise on liver, kidney and pancreas functions in middle-aged men

population.description: Eighteen healthy middle-aged men (Methods: 'Eighteen healthy middle-aged male volunteers'; medical interview and examination, no chronic disease, no medication, non-smokers; inclusion over 40 years, so min and max are left null). Age and BMI are the values before the fast (Table 1); the same people are used for the after-fast arm, since the model spins them up through a normal fed day before the fast. Glucose tolerance was not tested. Not the cohort of pilis-2025 (13 men, 57.25 y, other ethics approval) or stec-2023: this paper's ethics document is KE-U/9/2024 (4 June 2024), 18 men aged 60.78 +/- 10.60.

protocols.name: rest_after_12h_night_fast
protocols.description: Rest blood sample in the laboratory in the morning before the 8-day fast, after 'a 12-hour long night break from meals' (stated). Clock hour not stated: 08:00 assumed. The sample has no stated moment within the run-in; a 30-minute run-in read at minute 29-30 stands for it.

protocols.name: rest_after_192h_water_fast
protocols.description: Rest blood sample in the laboratory after '8 days (192 h) of water-only fasting' (water ad libitum, about 3 L/day; no food), the procedure of the first visit repeated. prefast_hours = 192 is the paper's own '8 days (192 h)'. The paper prints no clock times: not when the fast began relative to the first-day sample (a fast begun at the first visit, itself after a 12 h break, would make 12 + 192 = 204 h at the second sample) nor when the second visit fell, so whether the 192 h run to the blood draw is assumed. Clock hour not stated (morning visit as before): 08:00 assumed; 30-minute run-in assumed.

left_out.what: Serum cortisol, rest before and after the fast and after the exercise test (Table 2, row C): printed as 309.19 +/- 92.70 and 479.33 +/- 123.54 ng/ml at rest; read as ng/ml these are 30.9 and 47.9 ug/dL, outside the plausible range, so the printed unit contradicts the numbers (probably nmol/L). Same assay and laboratory as pilis-2025, whose cortisol was left out for the same reason.

Serum and capillary values 3 min after a maximal incremental cycle test to exhaustion (starting 30 W, +30 W every 3 min), before and after the fast: beta-hydroxybutyrate, cortisol (Table 2, columns 3 and 4), lactate (Table 3, columns 3 and 4)
